"""Optimized paper figures — unified publication-quality style.

Palette: Unified semantic (project-specified)
Font: Liberation Serif
All figures share identical rcParams for cross-figure consistency.

Data verified against published paper text (Tables 1, 2, 4, tau, rho06, dr_threshold).
tau=0.8 at rho=0.4 corrected for resume artifact (Appendix H): 17.683 not 17.653.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import brentq
from pathlib import Path

OUT = Path(__file__).parent

# ── Semantic palette ──
C = {
    'baseline':  '#4A90D9',   # steel blue — Adaptive b* / primary data / ours
    'treatment': '#E8913A',   # warm amber — ESS-only / contrast methods
    'collapse':  '#C75C5C',   # muted coral — Random / degradation / failure
    'safe':      '#43A888',   # sage green — Grid-best / Oracle / D&R / good outcome
    'neutral':   '#90A4AE',   # blue-gray — Uniform baseline / reference
}

# ── Premium rcParams (publication-grade, PaperBanana-equivalent) ──
PREMIUM_RC = {
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Liberation Serif', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'mathtext.fontset': 'dejavuserif',
    'font.size': 8.5,
    'axes.titlesize': 9.5,
    'axes.labelsize': 9,
    'xtick.labelsize': 7.5,
    'ytick.labelsize': 7.5,
    'legend.fontsize': 7,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.axisbelow': True,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.5,  'ytick.major.width': 0.5,
    'xtick.minor.width': 0.3,  'ytick.minor.width': 0.3,
    'xtick.major.size': 3.5,   'ytick.major.size': 3.5,
    'xtick.minor.size': 2.0,   'ytick.minor.size': 2.0,
    'xtick.direction': 'out',  'ytick.direction': 'out',
    'xtick.major.pad': 4,      'ytick.major.pad': 4,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.5,
    'lines.markersize': 5,
    'legend.frameon': False,
    'legend.borderpad': 0.3,
    'legend.handlelength': 1.5,
    'legend.handletextpad': 0.5,
    'legend.columnspacing': 1.0,
    'grid.linewidth': 0.3,
    'grid.alpha': 0.4,
    'grid.linestyle': '--',
    'grid.color': '#E0E0E0',
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.04,
    'savefig.facecolor': 'white',
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
}
plt.rcParams.update(PREMIUM_RC)

GRID_KW = dict(axis='y', lw=0.3, alpha=0.4, color='#E0E0E0', linestyle='--')
GRID_XY = dict(axis='both', lw=0.3, alpha=0.4, color='#E0E0E0', linestyle='--')
STROKE = [pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')]


def _save(fig, name):
    for ext in ('pdf', 'png'):
        fig.savefig(OUT / f'{name}.{ext}', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight',
                    pad_inches=0.04)
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f'  ✓ {name}')


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Figure 2 — dual_constraint_illustration  (figure*, \textwidth)
# Narrative: Show two constraint regimes with clear visual separation
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def fig_dual_constraint():
    B = 4;  tau = 0.7;  n_min_ratio = 0.5

    def alpha_eff(b, q):
        w = (1 - q)**b
        return np.sum(w * (1 - q)) / np.sum(w)

    def ess_norm(b, q, B):
        w = (1 - q)**b
        return (np.sum(w)**2 / np.sum(w**2)) / B

    q_a = np.array([0.08, 0.42, 0.62, 0.78])
    q_b = np.array([0.20, 0.50, 0.85, 0.95])
    b_range = np.linspace(0, 5.5, 500)

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(6.75, 2.7), sharey=True)
    plt.subplots_adjust(wspace=0.08)

    for ax, q, panel_label, panel_title in [
        (ax1, q_a, '(a)', r'$\alpha_{\mathrm{eff}}$-binding: $b^* = b_\tau$'),
        (ax2, q_b, '(b)', r'ESS-binding: $b^* = b_{\mathrm{ESS}}$'),
    ]:
        aeff_vals = np.array([alpha_eff(b, q) for b in b_range])
        ess_vals  = np.array([ess_norm(b, q, B) for b in b_range])

        if aeff_vals[0] < tau and aeff_vals[-1] >= tau:
            bt = brentq(lambda b: alpha_eff(b, q) - tau, 0, 20)
        elif aeff_vals[-1] < tau:
            bt = None
        else:
            bt = 0

        be = (brentq(lambda b: ess_norm(b, q, B) - n_min_ratio, 0, 20)
              if ess_vals[-1] < n_min_ratio else None)
        is_aeff_binding = (bt is not None and be is not None and bt <= be)

        # Background shading
        if is_aeff_binding:
            ax.axvspan(bt, be, alpha=0.12, color=C['safe'], zorder=0)
            ax.axvspan(be, 5.5, alpha=0.06, color=C['collapse'], zorder=0)
            ax.text((bt + be) / 2, 0.04, 'feasible', fontsize=7, ha='center',
                    color=C['safe'], alpha=0.7, fontstyle='italic')
        else:
            if be is not None:
                ax.axvspan(be, 5.5, alpha=0.06, color=C['collapse'], zorder=0)

        # Curves — alpha_eff = baseline (steel blue), ESS = treatment (amber)
        ax.plot(b_range, aeff_vals, color=C['baseline'], linewidth=1.8,
                label=r'$\alpha_{\mathrm{eff}}(b)$', zorder=3)
        ax.plot(b_range, ess_vals, color=C['treatment'], linewidth=1.8,
                label=r'$\mathrm{ESS}(b)/B$', zorder=3)

        # Threshold lines
        ax.axhline(tau, color=C['baseline'], linestyle='--', linewidth=0.7,
                   alpha=0.4, zorder=2)
        ax.axhline(n_min_ratio, color=C['treatment'], linestyle='--',
                   linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.4, zorder=2)

        # Threshold labels (right side)
        t1 = ax.text(5.35, tau + 0.025, r'$\tau$', fontsize=8,
                     color=C['baseline'], ha='right', va='bottom')
        t1.set_path_effects(STROKE)
        t2 = ax.text(5.35, n_min_ratio - 0.035, r'$n_{\min}\!/B$', fontsize=7,
                     color=C['treatment'], ha='right', va='top')
        t2.set_path_effects(STROKE)

        if is_aeff_binding:
            bstar = bt
            ax.axvline(bstar, color='#444444', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.7,
                       alpha=0.3, zorder=2)
            ax.plot(bstar, tau, 'o', color=C['safe'], markersize=7,
                    markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.0, zorder=5)
            t_bs = ax.annotate(
                r'$b^*\!=\!b_\tau$', xy=(bstar, tau),
                xytext=(bstar + 0.6, tau + 0.14), fontsize=8.5,
                fontweight='bold', color=C['safe'],
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C['safe'], lw=0.9,
                                connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.2'), zorder=6)
            t_bs.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])
            ax.plot(be, n_min_ratio, 'x', color=C['treatment'], markersize=4.5,
                    markeredgewidth=1.2, zorder=4, alpha=0.4)
            t3 = ax.text(be + 0.12, n_min_ratio - 0.06, r'$b_{\mathrm{ESS}}$',
                         fontsize=7, color=C['treatment'], alpha=0.4, va='top')
            t3.set_path_effects(STROKE)
        else:
            bstar = be
            ax.axvline(bstar, color='#444444', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.7,
                       alpha=0.3, zorder=2)
            ax.plot(bstar, n_min_ratio, 'o', color=C['safe'], markersize=7,
                    markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.0, zorder=5)
            t_bs = ax.annotate(
                r'$b^*\!=\!b_{\mathrm{ESS}}$', xy=(bstar, n_min_ratio),
                xytext=(bstar - 1.1, n_min_ratio - 0.18), fontsize=8.5,
                fontweight='bold', color=C['safe'],
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C['safe'], lw=0.9,
                                connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.2'), zorder=6)
            t_bs.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])
            if bt is not None and bt < 5.5:
                ax.plot(bt, tau, 'x', color=C['baseline'], markersize=4.5,
                        markeredgewidth=1.2, zorder=4, alpha=0.35)
                t3 = ax.text(bt + 0.12, tau + 0.04, r'$b_\tau$', fontsize=7,
                             color=C['baseline'], alpha=0.4)
                t3.set_path_effects(STROKE)

        ax.set_title(panel_title, fontsize=9, pad=8)
        ax.text(0.02, 0.97, panel_label, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=10,
                fontweight='bold', va='top', ha='left')
        ax.set_xlabel('Sharpening exponent $b$')
        ax.set_xlim(0, 5.5)
        ax.set_ylim(0, 1.05)

    ax1.set_ylabel('Normalized value')
    handles, labels = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
    ax1.legend(handles, labels, loc='upper right', framealpha=0.92,
               edgecolor='none', borderpad=0.3, handlelength=1.5)

    fig.tight_layout(w_pad=0.6)
    _save(fig, 'dual_constraint_illustration')

#            in the degradation zone

    ax.set_ylabel('Held-out PPL')
    ax.set_xlim(-0.2, 5.7)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Figure A.1 — constraint_regime_decomposition  (figure, \columnwidth)
# Narrative: α_eff-binding dominates at ρ=0.4; constraints balance
#            at ρ=0.6
# Data: Section 4.4 + Appendix D (seed 42, 3-seed avg)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def fig_constraint_regime():
    labels = [r'$\rho{=}0.4$', r'$\rho{=}0.6$']
    aeff   = [50.9, 46.8]
    ess    = [43.3, 48.7]
    clean  = [ 5.8,  4.5]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.1, 2.6))
    x = np.arange(len(labels))
    w = 0.50

    # Bars — alpha_eff = baseline (steel blue), ESS = treatment (amber)
    ax.bar(x, aeff, w, color=C['baseline'], alpha=0.85,

           label=r'$\alpha_{\mathrm{eff}}$-binding', zorder=2)
    ax.bar(x, ess, w, bottom=aeff, color=C['treatment'], alpha=0.85,

def fig_tau_rho():

             markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.3,
             label=r'$\rho{=}0.4$', zorder=3)
    ax1.plot(t06, p06, 's-', color=C['treatment'], markersize=4,
             markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.3,
             label=r'$\rho{=}0.6$', zorder=3)

    # Uniform baselines
    ax1.axhline(u04, color=C['baseline'], ls='--', lw=0.7, alpha=0.4)
    ax1.axhline(u06, color=C['treatment'], ls='--', lw=0.7, alpha=0.4)
    t_u04 = ax1.text(0.96, u04 + 0.001, f'{u04:.3f}', fontsize=7,
                     color=C['baseline'], alpha=0.6, ha='right', va='bottom')
    t_u04.set_path_effects(STROKE)
    t_u06 = ax1.text(0.96, u06 + 0.001, f'{u06:.3f}', fontsize=7,
                     color=C['treatment'], alpha=0.6, ha='right', va='bottom')
    t_u06.set_path_effects(STROKE)

    # Optimal markers — τ=0.7 is best at both ρ
    ax1.plot(0.7, rho04[0.7], '*', color=C['baseline'], markersize=9,
             markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.3, zorder=4)
    ax1.plot(0.7, rho06[0.7], '*', color=C['treatment'], markersize=9,
             markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.3, zorder=4)
    ax1.annotate(r'$\tau^*{=}0.7$', xy=(0.7, rho04[0.7]),
                 xytext=(0.78, 17.668), fontsize=7.5, color=C['baseline'],
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C['baseline'], lw=0.6))

    ax1.set_xlabel(r'Quality threshold $\tau$')
    ax1.set_ylabel('Held-out PPL')
    ax1.set_title('(a)', loc='left', fontweight='bold', fontsize=9)
    ax1.set_xlim(0.45, 0.99)
    ax1.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=7, framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='none')
    ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FormatStrFormatter('%.2f'))
    ax1.grid(**GRID_KW)
    ax1.set_axisbelow(True)

    # ── Panel (b): normalized gap ──
    shared = [0.6, 0.7, 0.8]
    g04 = [(rho04[t] - u04) / u04 * 100 for t in shared]
    g06 = [(rho06[t] - u06) / u06 * 100 for t in shared]
    bw = 0.30
    xb = np.arange(len(shared))

    ax2.bar(xb - bw/2, g04, bw, color=C['baseline'], alpha=0.85,
            label=r'$\rho{=}0.4$', edgecolor='white', lw=0.3)
    ax2.bar(xb + bw/2, g06, bw, color=C['treatment'], alpha=0.85,
            label=r'$\rho{=}0.6$', edgecolor='white', lw=0.3)

    ax2.set_xlabel(r'Quality threshold $\tau$')
    ax2.set_ylabel('Gap vs. uniform (%)')
    ax2.set_title('(b)', loc='left', fontweight='bold', fontsize=9)
    ax2.set_xticks(xb)
    ax2.set_xticklabels([str(t) for t in shared])
    ax2.set_xlim(-0.55, 2.55)
    ax2.legend(loc='lower left', fontsize=7, framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='none')
    ax2.grid(**GRID_KW)
    ax2.set_axisbelow(True)
    ax2.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FormatStrFormatter('%.2f'))

    fig.tight_layout()
    _save(fig, 'tau_rho_rank_preservation')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

OUT = Path(__file__).parent

C = {
    'primary':   '#4A90D9',
    'secondary': '#E8913A',
    'tertiary':  '#43A888',
    'negative':  '#C75C5C',
    'neutral':   '#90A4AE',
}

# ── Premium rcParams (publication-grade, PaperBanana-equivalent) ──
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Liberation Serif', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'mathtext.fontset': 'dejavuserif',
    'font.size': 8.5,
    'axes.titlesize': 9.5,
    'axes.labelsize': 9,
    'xtick.labelsize': 7.5,
    'ytick.labelsize': 7.5,
    'legend.fontsize': 7,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.axisbelow': True,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.5,  'ytick.major.width': 0.5,
    'xtick.minor.width': 0.3,  'ytick.minor.width': 0.3,
    'xtick.major.size': 3.5,   'ytick.major.size': 3.5,
    'xtick.minor.size': 2.0,   'ytick.minor.size': 2.0,
    'xtick.direction': 'out',  'ytick.direction': 'out',
    'xtick.major.pad': 4,      'ytick.major.pad': 4,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.5,
    'lines.markersize': 5,
    'legend.frameon': False,
    'legend.borderpad': 0.3,
    'legend.handlelength': 1.5,
    'legend.handletextpad': 0.5,
    'grid.linewidth': 0.3,
    'grid.alpha': 0.4,
    'grid.linestyle': '--',
    'grid.color': '#E0E0E0',
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.04,
    'savefig.facecolor': 'white',
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

STROKE = [pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')]


def _save(fig, name):
    for ext in ('pdf', 'png'):
        fig.savefig(OUT / f'{name}.{ext}', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight',
                    pad_inches=0.04)
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f'  ✓ {name}')


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# batch_size_amplification — bar chart
# Data from §5.3: B=4 Δ=-0.023±0.006 (1.0×), B=8 Δ=-0.052±0.007 (2.3×),
#                  B=16 Δ=-0.068±0.005 (3.0×)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def fig_batch_amp():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.3, 2.4))

    batches = ['B=4', 'B=8', 'B=16']
    deltas = [-0.023, -0.052, -0.068]
    stds = [0.006, 0.007, 0.005]
    amplifications = [1.0, 2.3, 3.0]
    colors = [C['primary'], C['primary'], C['primary']]

    x = np.arange(len(batches))
    bars = ax.bar(x, [-d for d in deltas], width=0.55, color=colors,
                  edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.85, zorder=3)
    ax.errorbar(x, [-d for d in deltas], yerr=stds, fmt='none',
                ecolor='#555555', capsize=3, capthick=0.8, linewidth=0.8, zorder=4)

    # Baseline reference
    ax.axhline(0.023, color=C['neutral'], linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8,
               alpha=0.5, zorder=2)
    t = ax.text(2.35, 0.024, 'Baseline (1.0×)', fontsize=6.5,
                color=C['neutral'], ha='right', va='bottom')

    # Amplification labels
    for i, (amp, delta, sd) in enumerate(zip(amplifications, deltas, stds)):
        label = f'{amp:.1f}×\n($\\Delta$={delta:+.3f}±{sd:.3f})'
        t = ax.text(i, -delta + sd + 0.003, label, ha='center', va='bottom',
                    fontsize=6.5, color='#333333', linespacing=1.2)

    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(batches)
    ax.set_xlabel('Micro-batch size')
    ax.set_ylabel('Amplification factor\n(|$\\Delta$ PPL| vs. uniform)')
    ax.set_ylim(0, 0.095)
    ax.grid(axis='y', lw=0.3, alpha=0.35, color='#E0E0E0', linestyle='--')

    _save(fig, 'batch_size_amplification')


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import brentq

# ── Premium rcParams (publication-grade, PaperBanana-equivalent) ──
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Liberation Serif', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'mathtext.fontset': 'dejavuserif',
    'font.size': 8.5,
    'axes.titlesize': 9.5,
    'axes.labelsize': 9,
    'xtick.labelsize': 7.5,
    'ytick.labelsize': 7.5,
    'legend.fontsize': 7,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.axisbelow': True,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.5,  'ytick.major.width': 0.5,
    'xtick.minor.width': 0.3,  'ytick.minor.width': 0.3,
    'xtick.major.size': 3.5,   'ytick.major.size': 3.5,
    'xtick.minor.size': 2.0,   'ytick.minor.size': 2.0,
    'xtick.direction': 'out',  'ytick.direction': 'out',
    'xtick.major.pad': 4,      'ytick.major.pad': 4,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.5,
    'lines.markersize': 5,
    'legend.frameon': False,
    'legend.borderpad': 0.3,
    'legend.handlelength': 1.5,
    'legend.handletextpad': 0.5,
    'grid.linewidth': 0.3,
    'grid.alpha': 0.4,
    'grid.linestyle': '--',
    'grid.color': '#E0E0E0',
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.04,
    'savefig.facecolor': 'white',
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

C = {
    'baseline':  '#4A90D9',   # steel blue — Adaptive b* / primary data / ours
    'treatment': '#E8913A',   # warm amber — ESS-only / contrast methods
    'collapse':  '#C75C5C',   # muted coral — Random / degradation / failure
    'safe':      '#43A888',   # sage green — Grid-best / Oracle / D&R / good outcome
    'neutral':   '#90A4AE',   # blue-gray — Uniform baseline / reference
}

B = 4
tau = 0.7
n_min_ratio = 0.5

def alpha_eff(b, q):
    w = (1 - q)**b
    return np.sum(w * (1 - q)) / np.sum(w)

def ess_norm(b, q, B):
    w = (1 - q)**b
    return (np.sum(w)**2 / np.sum(w**2)) / B

q_a = np.array([0.08, 0.42, 0.62, 0.78])
q_b = np.array([0.20, 0.50, 0.85, 0.95])

b_range = np.linspace(0, 5.5, 500)

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(6.8, 2.6), sharey=True)
plt.subplots_adjust(wspace=0.08)

for idx, (ax, q, panel_label, panel_title) in enumerate([
    (ax1, q_a, '(a)', r'$\alpha_{\mathrm{eff}}$-binding: $b^* = b_\tau$'),
    (ax2, q_b, '(b)', r'ESS-binding: $b^* = b_{\mathrm{ESS}}$'),
]):
    aeff_vals = np.array([alpha_eff(b, q) for b in b_range])
    ess_vals = np.array([ess_norm(b, q, B) for b in b_range])

    if aeff_vals[0] < tau and aeff_vals[-1] >= tau:
        bt = brentq(lambda b: alpha_eff(b, q) - tau, 0, 20)
    elif aeff_vals[-1] < tau:
        bt = None
    else:
        bt = 0

    be = brentq(lambda b: ess_norm(b, q, B) - n_min_ratio, 0, 20) if ess_vals[-1] < n_min_ratio else None

    is_aeff_binding = (bt is not None and be is not None and bt <= be)

    # Background shading
    if is_aeff_binding:
        ax.axvspan(bt, be, alpha=0.12, color=C['safe'], zorder=0)
        ax.axvspan(be, 5.5, alpha=0.06, color=C['collapse'], zorder=0)
        t = ax.text((bt + be) / 2, 0.04, 'feasible', fontsize=7, ha='center',
                    color=C['safe'], alpha=0.8, fontstyle='italic')
    else:
        if be is not None:
            ax.axvspan(be, 5.5, alpha=0.06, color=C['collapse'], zorder=0)

    # Curves — alpha_eff = baseline (steel blue), ESS = treatment (amber)
    ax.plot(b_range, aeff_vals, color=C['baseline'], linewidth=1.8,
            label=r'$\alpha_{\mathrm{eff}}(b)$', zorder=3)
    ax.plot(b_range, ess_vals, color=C['treatment'], linewidth=1.8,
            label=r'$\mathrm{ESS}(b)/B$', zorder=3)

    # Threshold lines
    ax.axhline(tau, color=C['baseline'], linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8,
               alpha=0.4, zorder=2)
    ax.axhline(n_min_ratio, color=C['treatment'], linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8,
               alpha=0.4, zorder=2)

    # Threshold labels
    t1 = ax.text(5.35, tau + 0.025, r'$\tau$', fontsize=8, color=C['baseline'],
                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')
    t1.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])
    t2 = ax.text(5.35, n_min_ratio - 0.035, r'$n_{\min}\!/B$', fontsize=7,
                 color=C['treatment'], ha='right', va='top', fontweight='bold')
    t2.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

    if is_aeff_binding:
        bstar = bt
        ax.axvline(bstar, color='#444444', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.35, zorder=2)
        ax.plot(bstar, tau, 'o', color=C['safe'], markersize=8,
                markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.2, zorder=5)
        t_bstar = ax.annotate(r'$b^*\!=\!b_\tau$', xy=(bstar, tau),
                    xytext=(bstar + 0.6, tau + 0.14),
                    fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=C['safe'],
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C['safe'],
                                    lw=1.0, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.2'),
                    zorder=6)
        t_bstar.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])
        # Non-binding b_ESS
        ax.plot(be, n_min_ratio, 'x', color=C['treatment'],
                markersize=5, markeredgewidth=1.3, zorder=4, alpha=0.45)
        t3 = ax.text(be + 0.12, n_min_ratio - 0.06, r'$b_{\mathrm{ESS}}$',
                     fontsize=7, color=C['treatment'], alpha=0.45, va='top')
        t3.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])
    else:
        bstar = be
        ax.axvline(bstar, color='#444444', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.35, zorder=2)
        ax.plot(bstar, n_min_ratio, 'o', color=C['safe'], markersize=8,
                markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.2, zorder=5)
        t_bstar = ax.annotate(r'$b^*\!=\!b_{\mathrm{ESS}}$', xy=(bstar, n_min_ratio),
                    xytext=(bstar - 1.1, n_min_ratio - 0.18),
                    fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=C['safe'],
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C['safe'],
                                    lw=1.0, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.2'),
                    zorder=6)
        t_bstar.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])
        # Non-binding b_tau
        if bt is not None and bt < 5.5:
            ax.plot(bt, tau, 'x', color=C['baseline'],
                    markersize=5, markeredgewidth=1.3, zorder=4, alpha=0.35)
            t3 = ax.text(bt + 0.12, tau + 0.04, r'$b_\tau$',
                         fontsize=7, color=C['baseline'], alpha=0.4)
            t3.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

    ax.set_title(panel_title, fontsize=9, pad=8)
    ax.text(-0.02, 1.08, panel_label, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=10,
            fontweight='bold', va='bottom', ha='left')
    ax.set_xlabel('Sharpening exponent $b$')
    ax.set_xlim(0, 5.5)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1.05)

ax1.set_ylabel('Normalized value')

handles, labels = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax1.legend(handles, labels, loc='lower left', framealpha=0, edgecolor='none',
           borderpad=0.3, handlelength=1.5)

plt.tight_layout(w_pad=0.6)

outdir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_10/projects/provenance_weight_training/artifacts/figures'

plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/dual_constraint_illustration.png')
